description: Conservative baseline configuration for a small tabular dataset (~2.3k rows, 1.4k patients). Hyperparameters are intentionally few: no broad tuning is performed on this small dataset.

split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=20) at row level with patient_id groups; folds 0-2 = test, folds 3-5 = validation, folds 6-19 = train

model.notes: Classes are nearly balanced (1089 cancer vs 1209 non-cancer overall), so scale_pos_weight is left at 1.0. Early stopping uses the VALIDATION split only (logloss). Depth 3 and min_child_weight 3 keep trees shallow for this small dataset.

threshold_selection.method: sweep 0.05..0.95 (step 0.01) on the VALIDATION split, maximise cancer-class F1; ties broken by higher recall, then by proximity to 0.5

missingness_analysis.sensitivity_experiment: refit identical pipeline (same hyperparameters, same seed, same patient-grouped splits) on the survey-present sub-cohort only; exploratory, not the primary model
